20% CAPEX BOOST LIFTS DEFENCE STOCKS

The Defence Ministry has asked for a 20% increase in capital spending for FY27‑28. For FY27, defence capital allocation reached ₹2.19 lakh crore, a 22% rise over the FY26 estimate of ₹1.8 lakh crore.
Analysts note that HAL, BEL, L&T, Bharat Forge and BEML could see higher orders as the higher budget translates into more procurement for the armed forces.

For information only. Not investment advice.
